newsitem.title: UK: Blue Circle, Lend Lease Corp joint venture. [CORRECTED 10:39 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Blue Circle, Lend Lease Corp joint venture. [CORRECTED 10:39 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects company name in headline and text to Lend Lease Corp from Land Lease Corp)
Blue Circle Industries Plc and Lend Lease Corporation said on Tuesday they had agreed to form a joint venture to plan and develop surplus land holdings in BCI's UK land bank.
The venture will initially focus on Kent, looking in particular at 2,250 acres in the northwest of the county, which is in southeast England.
This area is already subject to plans for commercial and housing development around the proposed new Ebbsfleet station for the Channel Tunnel Rail Link.
The new venture will be called Whitecliff Properties, with a board of six members, with equal representation from both sides.
Stuart Hornery, chairman of LLC has been appointed chairman of the venture. Blue Circle chief executive Keith Orrell-Jones will take on the deputy chairman's role.
Tony Kemp, Blue Circle's property director, will be chief executive of the venture and John McCready, also from Blue Circle will be the finance chief.
Overhead costs are to be split and an agreement on the venture is to be signed later this year.
